name: kb_protection_paladin
notes: The knowledge base's protection paladin: Righteous Fury and Sanctity Aura, a seal, Holy Strike and Judgement on cooldown with a re-seal after each judgement, Holy Shield when mana permits, Consecration at full rank above 30% mana and rank 1 below, Seal of Wisdom when the mana runs low. Taunting stays with role_tank; Exorcism's creature gate and the fight-timeline rows are listed in kb.unexpressed.

priorities.note: the power gate hands the seal to Seal of Wisdom below 20% mana (rotation_aoe[6])
